narr: The remnants of Ida produced widespread flooding along with instances of flash flooding across the area. Tropical moisture infiltrated the area and there were moderate amounts of instability as well. This combined with the lift provided from the remnants of Ida led to heavy rainfall during this time. Rainfall amounts averaged around 1-3 near and east of Interstate 95, with amounts around 2 to 5 inches across portions of northern Virginia.
ev: High water rapidly developed along 5th Street and Harris Road due to heavy rainfall, causing the road to be closed.
High water that rapidly developed along with storm debris blocked VA-674 both ways at Difficult Run River between Cedar Pond Drive and Hunter Station Road.
